        address:
          title: Address

            it is stored and returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and
            internal runs of whitespace collapsed to a single space, it is

            whole words (ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE), e.g. '  12  main

            normalization is rejected.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"

          description: >-

      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of
                owners already in that city when this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier linking owners that belong to the
                same household (same lastName and address). Assigned when an
                owner is created and joins an existing household; all members of
                a household share the same value. Absent for owners that do not
                belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 form, the email the
                stored lower-cased form (empty when absent) and householdId the
                shared household identifier (empty when the owner does not belong
                to a shared household). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict
                only when this whole key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true

              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the moment this
                owner was created, sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number

              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. The value is normalized before
            it is stored and returned: surrounding whitespace is trimmed and
            internal runs of whitespace collapsed to a single space, it is
            upper-cased, and common street-type abbreviations are expanded as
            whole words (ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE), e.g. '  12  main
            st ' is stored as '12 MAIN STREET'. An address that is blank after
            normalization is rejected.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' and is
            stored and returned in that canonical form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: |-
            @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
            @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag; it is not persisted or returned. Retained
            for backwards compatibility: duplicate detection is now based solely
            on the derived identityKey, so sharing a household (same lastName and
            address) with a different telephone is always allowed and this flag
            no longer affects whether a create is accepted.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of
                owners already in that city when this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier linking owners that belong to the
                same household (same lastName and address). Assigned when an
                owner is created and joins an existing household; all members of
                a household share the same value. Absent for owners that do not
                belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 form, the email the
                stored lower-cased form (empty when absent) and householdId the
                shared household identifier (empty when the owner does not belong
                to a shared household). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict
                only when this whole key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the moment this
                owner was created, sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, assigned at
                creation. Starts at 1; adds 1 when an email is present; adds 1
                when the owner's name was unique at creation time (namesakeCount
                is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by
                registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created, flagging a
                bulk signup; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

        totalPages:

        - totalElements

          title: Address
          description: >-

            upper-cased, and common street-type abbreviations are expanded as

        city:

            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; an explicit
            leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national

          x-field-extra-annotation: |-

              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'

                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city

              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                owner is created and joins an existing household; all members of
                a household share the same value. Absent for owners that do not
                belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'

              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true

              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the moment this
                owner was created, sharing the same firstName and lastName

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

## What I changed

The app generates its request/response DTOs from `openapi.yml` at build time, so the contract lives there. Postcode is a cross-field rule (depends on both `city` and `postcode`), so I used a class-level Bean Validation constraint plus field-level format.

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `postcode` field to `OwnerFields` with `pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"` (4-digit format), and attached a class-level `@PostcodeValidation` annotation to the schema via `x-class-extra-annotation`. 2. **`PostcodeRules`** (util) — single source of truth for the fixed tables: city→region (`Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD`) and region→inclusive range (`NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099`). Returns valid when the postcode is absent, not 4 digits (deferred to `@Pattern`), the city has no known region (permissive default), or the value is in range; invalid only when a 4-digit postcode is out of its city's region range.

3. **`PostcodeValidation` + `PostcodeValidator`** — a `@Target(TYPE)` constraint on the `OwnerFieldsDto` request body that delegates to `PostcodeRules`, producing a 400 on an out-of-range postcode.

4. **`Owner` entity** — added the `postcode` column and accessors; MapStruct auto-maps it in both directions, so it is stored and returned.

5. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.updateOwner`** — carries `postcode` through on update for consistency.

6. **DB schemas** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `postcode` column to the `owners` table.

## How the behaviors map to the spec
- Valid postcode for city → stored and returned (`coreStoresValidPostcode`).
- Absent postcode → accepted (`coreAcceptsOwnerWithoutPostcode`).
- Malformed postcode (`"12"`) → 400 via `@Pattern` (`errorRejectsMalformedPostcode`).
- Out-of-range for the city's region → 400 via the class-level validator; unknown-region city accepts any 4-digit value.

Since the task touched a stored field plus a fixed lookup table that's already enumerated in the spec and tests, there's nothing non-obvious worth persisting to memory.
